why_no_retrain: No reproducible implementation/numerical/budget error. Fixed-weight scalar and dual traces yield the same weighted advantage at equal predictions; diagnostics find component alignment differences but nearly unchanged weighted residuals. No evidence justifies blind longer training or weakening ScalarValue.
core_finding: Separate supervision constrains each prediction to its own terminal metric; the scalar control only constrains their weighted sum. Better component correspondence has not yielded consistent configuration gains.
single_critic_note: A capacity-matched single-critic arm tests network architecture, a different question from the current loss-supervision diagnosis; it is not needed to repair the verified correct comparison.
new_diagnosis_scope: New external scenarios within known validation image pool, stochastic frozen policies; own occupancy realized-return residuals, not common-public-state conditional-value truth or formal TEST.
